description: Compare two or three AI tools head-to-head. Returns pricing, features, GateOnAI scores, pros/cons, and a recommendation on which tool to choose.

tool1_slug.description: URL slug of the first tool to compare. Examples: 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'midjourney', 'jasper'

tool2_slug.description: URL slug of the second tool to compare. Examples: 'google-gemini', 'dall-e-3', 'elevenlabs', 'notion'

tool3_slug.description: Optional third tool slug for a 3-way comparison (e.g. 'perplexity')

name: compare_ai_tools

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Compare AI Tools
